vson_p:
# BeliefState example: a watchman believes that a thief is approaching the gate.
# Demonstrates: BeliefState node + experiencer (Endurant) + reified
# Annotation form for proposition (per spec §18 — RDF 1.1 portable
# equivalent of canonical <<s p o>>; conforms to vss:BeliefStateShape and
# vss:AnnotationShape).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 35mm :framing wide_shot)
   :viewedBy cam

   :depicts (watchman / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Named :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Role   :value watchman)
               :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Affect :value vigilant))

   :depicts (thief / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (q3 / Quality :dimension Role :value thief))

   :depicts (gate / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Architecture)

   :depicts (bs1 / BeliefState
               :experiencer watchman
               :proposition (b_ann / Annotation
                              :annotatedSubject thief
                              :annotatedPredicate near
                              :annotatedObject gate)))
